facts.statement: Keresdrakon lived during the Early Cretaceous period, specifically the Aptian to Albian stages, between 125 and 100.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: which dates back to the Early Cretaceous period (Aptian-Albian stages), 125 to 100.5 million years ago

facts.statement: The species Keresdrakon vilsoni was named and described in 2019 by Kellner, Weinschütz, Holgado, Bantim, and Sayão.
facts.quote: In 2019, the type species Keresdrakon vilsoni was named and described by Alexander Wilhelm Armin Kellner, Luiz Carlos Weinschütz, Borja Holgado, Renan Alfredo Machado Bantim and Juliana Manso Sayão

facts.statement: Because the name was published electronically, Life Science Identifiers were required to validate the taxon's name.
facts.quote: As the name appeared in an electronic publication, Life Science Identifiers were needed for its validity

facts.statement: The holotype specimen consists of a partial skeleton that includes a skull.
facts.quote: The holotype consists of a partial skeleton with skull

facts.statement: The holotype skeleton is not articulated.
The bones of the holotype are largely three-dimensionally preserved with little compression and belong to a subadult individual.
facts.quote: The bones have largely been three-dimensionally preserved, with little compression, and represent a subadult individual

facts.statement: The age of the Goio-Erê Formation is disputed, ranging potentially from the Aptian to the Campanian.
facts.quote: The age of this formation is disputed; it could be as old as the Aptian but also as young as the Campanian

facts.statement: Fossils of Keresdrakon were found in direct association with Caiuajara and Vespersaurus, confirming these species were sympatric.
facts.quote: The fossils of Keresdrakon were found in direct association with the tapejarid Caiuajara and the noasaurid theropod Vespersaurus, confirming that these species were sympatric

facts.statement: This discovery represents the first direct evidence of sympatry among pterosaurs, showing direct association rather than just co-occurrence in the same stratigraphic unit.
facts.quote: Among pterosaurs, this is the first direct evidence of sympatry, i.e. direct association instead of being found in the same stratigraphic unit

facts.statement: In the bone beds, Keresdrakon was the least common of the three pterosaur taxa present, while Caiuajara was the most common.
facts.quote: Of the three taxa in the bone beds, Caiuajara is the most common, and Keresdrakon is the least common

facts.statement: Sedimentological data indicates that the environment of the Goio-Erê Formation was a desert.
facts.quote: Sedimentological data indicates that the environment of the Goio-Erê Formation was a desert

facts.statement: Researchers suggest that Keresdrakon may have been an opportunistic predator in its desert environment, based on its azhdarchid-like rostrum.
facts.quote: the azhdarchid-like rostrum of Keresdrakon implies it may have been an opportunistic predator in this environment

facts.statement: The Paleobiology Database lists the time range for Keresdrakon as Aptian to Campanian, from 121.4 to 72.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Campanian (121.4 to 72.2 million years ago)
